text:
Love

from the shadow

from pain

love

I am calling you

from the suffocating well of memory

with nothing to sustain me or wait for you.

I am calling you

love

as one calls to fate

as one calls to sleep

to peace

I am calling you

with my voice

with my body

with my life

with all I have

and do not have

with desperation

with thirst

with tears

as if you were air

and I were drowning

as if you were light

and I were dying.

From a blind night

from forgetting

from hours shut tight

in solitude

without tears or love

I am calling you

as one calls to death

love

as one calls to death.
